title: Asking For and Giving Directions
completion_message: ¡Muy bien! Ahora puedes pedir y dar indicaciones para llegar a reuniones, salas o lugares de negocio en inglés.

parts.visual: Para pedir: Excuse me, how do I get to...? (¿Cómo llego a...?). Where is the meeting room? (¿Dónde está la sala de reuniones?).
parts.audio: To ask: Excuse me, how do I get to? Where is the meeting room?

parts.visual: Para dar: Turn left / right (Gira a la izquierda / derecha). Go straight (Ve recto). Take the elevator (Toma el ascensor). It is on the second floor (Está en el segundo piso). It is next to / opposite / between (Está junto a / frente a / entre).
parts.audio: To give: Turn left or right. Go straight. Take the elevator. It is on the second floor. It is next to, opposite, or between.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige la expresión correcta para pedir o dar indicaciones.

questions.question: Excuse me, how do I ____ to the reception? (Llegar).
questions.explanation: How do I get to...? = ¿Cómo llego a...?

questions.question: ____ left at the elevator. (Gira).
questions.explanation: Turn left = gira a la izquierda.

questions.question: Take the ____ to the third floor. (Ascensor).
The restroom is ____ the elevator. (Junto a).
The cafeteria is ____ the main office. (Frente a).
questions.explanation: Opposite = frente a / al otro lado de.

questions.question: The conference room is ____ the lab and the office. (Entre).
It is at the ____ of the corridor. (Al final).
questions.explanation: At the end of the corridor = al final del pasillo.

questions.question: ____ right after the reception desk. (Gira).
questions.explanation: Turn right = gira a la derecha.

questions.question: ____ past the cafeteria. (Pasa / Camina más allá).
questions.explanation: Go past = pasar más allá de.

questions.question: It is the first door on your ____. (Izquierda).
questions.explanation: On your left = a tu izquierda.

questions.question: It is the last door on your ____. (Derecha).
questions.explanation: On your right = a tu derecha.

questions.question: Can you ____ me how to get there? (Decir).
Take the ____ down to the lobby. (Escaleras).
It is ____ the lobby on the right. (Pasando).
questions.explanation: Past the lobby = pasando el vestíbulo.

questions.question: You ____ miss it. (No puedes perdértelo).
questions.explanation: You can't miss it = no puedes perdértelo.

questions.question: Sorry, I ____ sure. I'm new here. (No estoy seguro).
questions.explanation: I am not sure = no estoy seguro.

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Escribe la palabra correcta para dar o pedir indicaciones.

questions.question: It is ____ the lab and the office. (Entre).
It is at the ____ of the corridor. (Final).
It is the first door on your ____. (Izquierda).

pairs.source: At the end of the corridor

stages.title: Listening Comprehension
stages.description: Escucha y selecciona la frase exacta.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: Excuse me, how do I get to the reception?
options: Excuse me, how do I get to the reception?
Excuse me, how do I get to the meeting room?
Sorry, how do I get to the reception?
Excuse me, where is the reception?
questions.correct_answer: Excuse me, how do I get to the reception?

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: Go straight and then turn right.
options: Go straight and then turn right.
Go straight and then turn left.
Go forward and then turn right.
questions.correct_answer: Go straight and then turn right.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: Take the elevator to the third floor.
options: Take the elevator to the third floor.
Take the stairs to the third floor.
Take the elevator to the second floor.
Use the elevator to the third floor.
questions.correct_answer: Take the elevator to the third floor.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: It is next to the elevator.
options: It is next to the elevator.
It was next to the elevator.
questions.correct_answer: It is next to the elevator.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: The cafeteria is opposite the main office.
options: The cafeteria is opposite the main office.
The cafeteria is next to the main office.
The restaurant is opposite the main office.
The cafeteria is opposite the reception.
questions.correct_answer: The cafeteria is opposite the main office.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: It is at the end of the corridor.
options: It is at the end of the corridor.
It is at the end of the hall.
It was at the end of the corridor.
It is at the bottom of the corridor.
questions.correct_answer: It is at the end of the corridor.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: It is the first door on your left.
options: It is the first door on your left.
It is the second door on your left.
It is the first door on your right.
It was the first door on your left.
questions.correct_answer: It is the first door on your left.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: Sorry, I am not sure. I'm new here.
options: Sorry, I am not sure. I'm new here.
Sorry, I don't know. I'm new here.
I am not sure. I'm new here.
Sorry, I am not sure. She is new here.
questions.correct_answer: Sorry, I am not sure. I'm new here.
